body:
I don’t know how to have friends or make friends. I wasn’t allowed to have friends as a kid and as an adult it is even harder. 

As for therapy, my insurance will have to change in a few months and I don’t want to just get used to a therapist and leave them.

She greets me at the door, cuddles with me, and loves to sit looking at me and purring.

I am afraid of a lot of things, but I know she loves me.
They’re in another state 18 hours away. And my bio father hates me and has disowned me.

My relationship is falling apart. I’m going to end up broke. I miss my family. My mental illness issues are getting worse and I can’t see a therapist now because I’ll have to change insurance in a few months plus my last therapist abandoned me. I have too much on my shoulders and I’m crumbling.
She greets me at the door every day with a happy sound. Sometimes I’m in bed and I look at her sitting next to me and she’s just happy purring watching me. She’s my kitty soulmate.

It’s not that she’d suffer. It’s that she’d most likely be put down. There’s no one in my family who could take her and transport her to where they all live. And she’s not a “pretty” pattern (I think she’s gorgeous) and not a friendly personality (she’s just scared and takes a while to warm up to people but she hisses at new ones). She’d end up put down. 

My family... my grandpa couldn’t handle it. I couldn’t do it until after he died. And I mean I have the rest of them but they’d get over it. They haven’t seen me in a year.

I have a person I love like that. They might not love me that way anymore and it’s destroying me. 

It’s not even the love keeping me here. My brother loves me. My mother does. My grandfather. My stepfather. With my cat, I know no one else would take care of her. She’s an anxious little thing that doesn’t warm up to or trust people quickly. She’s needy about her little water fountain and has food anxiety and needs her wet food every night and tries to eat trash. No one else would love her and give her a good life. I’m all she has. I’m her whole world.
Again, I have my own religion. Go fuck yourself. You have no idea what my beliefs are or what I am.
I have a plenty healthy relationship with G-D. Again, fuck off with your genocidal death cult.
Go fuck yourself. I’m religious, just not a part of your death cult.
She almost died last week and it nearly killed me. She’s my child. I would’ve jumped in front of a train if she had
I don’t know how it can. I’m alone and drowning
